messages:
jess (ops): RCA published for the degraded-serving incident (2025-01-12). Full doc: https://redwood.internal/rca/degraded-serving-2025-01-12 :link: TL;DR: a combination of an autoscaler config regression + a new kernel causing increased per-request memory usage led to node OOMs and coordinated fallback to smaller model variants. Mitigations applied during incident fixed the immediate symptoms.

jess (ops): Key links: RCA above, runbook edits PR: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/482, telemetry dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/serving/incident-2025-01-12

jess (ops): Action items (owners & due dates):
• aditya (sre) — revert autoscaler threshold change in prod config and add canary test (due 2025-01-20)
• morgan (eng-runtime) — investigate kernel regression with vendor (quantized-kernel-3.2) and propose pinned fallback (due 2025-01-24)
• sam (product) — update customer-facing incident note & coordinate outbound for customers on dedicated plans (due 2025-01-18)
• jess (ops) — add automatic detection alert for kv-cache memory spikes (due 2025-01-22)

aditya (sre): I started a rollback plan for the autoscaler change. Will post PR number once ready.

aditya (sre): PR: https://github.com/redwood/autoscaler/pull/759 — rolling out to canary now :eyes:

morgan (eng-runtime): Re kernel — we reproduced higher peak RSS on the quant kernel for long-context streams, vendor investigating. Will list mitigation options by Friday.

sam (product): For dedicated customers: using the template in the RCA, I'll send targeted emails and flag any with strict latency SLOs.

incident-bot: Incident 2025-01-12 severity=sev2 closed. Duration 2h 18m. RCA posted.

jess (ops): Follow-up checkpoint (30-min): 2025-01-27 10:00 PT — we'll review progress on action items and canary metrics. Invite: #postmortems-checkins calendar invite sent.

morgan (eng-runtime): Quick question — do we want to pin older kernel by default for Dedicated until vendor patch? Might reduce perf but increase stability.

aditya (sre): +1 to pin for Dedicated, can keep Hosted using rolling canaries. I'll add a config flag to toggle per-deployment kernel pinning (aditya will own).

sam (product): Sounds good. Add note to customer comms that we'll schedule a brief maintenance window if we pin kernels for Dedicated customers.

jess (ops): Thanks all. Please update the RCA checklist items in the doc as you make progress (edit rights: ops, sre, eng-runtime, product). Mark items done in the doc rather than in this thread. :white_check_mark:

morgan (eng-runtime): Noted — will update status for my ticket once vendor confirms patch timeline.

aditya (sre): Will post canary metrics snapshot here after the canary rollout completes (~30m).

sam (product): Acknowledged, will prep the customer note draft by EOD.

jess (ops): Closing thread for announcements — reply here only for checkpoint scheduling or blockers. For other updates, update the RCA doc or the linked PRs. Thanks everyone.
